corePassives.description: Kenpachi's Special Attack, Spiritual Pressure Burst, and Ultimate are Sever attacks that apply Sever Points to the enemy. Upon reaching 100 Sever Points, the enemy will be inflicted with Cleave. Applying Sever Attacks to a Cleaved enemy deals extra Cleave DMG equal to 20% of that attack, which counts as Ailment DMG, but no longer applies Sever Points.
corePassives.name: Cleave

corePassives.description: While Kenpachi is using Special Attacks, Spiritual Pressure Burst, or his Ultimate, his damage taken is reduced by 60%, and interruption resistance is increased.
corePassives.name: Selfless

corePassives.description: After the battle begins, Kenpachi gains 1 stack of Excitement every 2 seconds. Each stack increases his ATK by 2.5%, stacking up to 10 times.
corePassives.name: Excitement

corePassives.description:
Acquiring Frenzy increases the damage of Kenpachi's Special Attacks by 90% for the next 15 seconds. 
 Kenpachi gains 1 Frenzy upon defeating an enemy.
corePassives.name: De-Rust

rotations.name: Battle Lust
rotations.notes: His damage scales with missing HP — let him take a few hits before bursting.

skills.description:
Kenpachi wields his Zanpakuto to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 870% of ATK to the enemy ahead, and gains 1 Frenzy when the last strike lands. ~~Rampage Raid~~ Tap and hold the Basic Attack button when there's enough Frenzy 
 Kenpachi lunges forward with unstoppable momentum, slashing the enemy multiple times. Tapping Basic Attack again or holding it unleashes a powerful follow-up slash, dealing 5 hits for a total damage of 1772.5% of ATK as his Spiritual Pressure surges violently. ~~Malicious Blade Rip~~ War Wraith Status 
 Kenpachi slashes at the enemy with overwhelming power. Each hit deals damage equal to 122.5% of ATK and builds Ultimate Energy. When the Ultimate Energy is nearly full again, he unleashes a heavy strike dealing damage equal to 635% of ATK. Damage dealt by Malicious Blade Rip counts as Ultimate DMG.
skills.name: Slash Mania

skills.description:
Kenpachi charges forward with his Zanpakuto and deals damage up to 315% of ATK to all enemies in his path. Upon taking a hit or completing his charge, he lunges forward with a powerful thrust, dealing damage equal to 1240% of ATK and gaining 1 point of Frenzy. ~~Spiritual Pressure Burst~~ Max Spiritual Pressure 
 Kenpachi dashes to the target and releases a torrential surge of Spiritual Pressure, blasting them skyward before smashing the ground for a total damage of 345% of ATK. Afterward, time briefly stops. Tap Basic Attack to perform a follow-up attack that deals damage equal to 345% of ATK in a large area. Tap Basic Attack again after the first follow-up attack to release a second one, dealing damage equal 687.5% of ATK. Each follow-up attack consumes Spiritual Pressure. Dodging or waiting too long during the time stop ends the Spiritual Pressure Burst.
skills.name: Relentless Pursuit

skills.description:
Kenpachi removes the eyepatch and fully unleashes his Spiritual Pressure, slashing the enemy and dealing damage equal to 2542.5% of ATK. He the enters the War Wraith state for 15 seconds. During this state, his basic attacks are greatly enhanced and can still generate Ultimate Energy, but techniques cannot be used. ~~"Kendo"~~ War Wraith Status 
 Kenpachi grips his Zanpakuto with both hands and delivers a devastating strike, dealing damage equal to 4245% of ATK and ending the War Wraith state.
skills.name: Full Power

skills.description: Kenpachi counters the enemy's attack and slams them to the ground, dealing damage equal to 1250% of ATK and gaining 1 point of Frenzy.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Kenpachi gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. 
 Upon triggering Perfect Dodge, tapping Basic Attack immediately releases the 5th attack of the basic attack chain. If Perfect Dodge is triggered while performing a Special Attack, the 3rd hit of the Special Attack can be released directly.
skills.name: Flash Step
